ChatApiKey.description: A key pasted into one chat. The agent writes `[secret:<reference>]`.

savedAs.description: The saved key's name, once the person saved this one for every chat.

sessionLabel.description: The chat's title, when it still exists.

SavedApiKey.description: A key saved for every chat. The agent writes `[secret:<name>]`.

hosts.description: Sites the key may be sent to. Empty means none yet.

kind.description: The detector that recognized the value (`openai`, `github`, ...), or `custom`.

needsValue.description: Bridge cannot read the value back. The Keychain ties a saved key to the build that wrote it unless the build is signed with a team id, so a local rebuild needs the key pasted again.

canSave.description: False off macOS: keys can still be pasted into a chat, not saved.

proxyRunning.description: False when Bridge could not bind the loopback port agents call.
